correctness.rationale: Under the expressly assumed separated two-branch contractions and irrational Sturmian minimal set, p(n)=n+1 active atoms, and every itinerary length n contains k=n*rho+O(1) high symbols. Therefore each contraction product lambda^n mu^k lies in [B^-1 e^-chi*n,B e^-chi*n], chi=-(1-rho)log lambda-rho log(lambda mu)>0, B=exp(|log mu|). Atom diameter <=B e^-chi*n; two distinct atoms differ at some last-unequal branch, have gap >=g and retain >=g B^-1 exp(-chi(n-1)) under their shared final suffix, because intersecting with a branch domain cannot reduce separation. Each active atom meets K, giving a two-sided n+1 packing and cover squeeze with n=log(1/eps)/chi+O(1). Boundary requirements lambda,lambda mu in (0,1), g>0, irrational rho are explicit, with no rational or overlapping-image generalization. Independently regenerated mechanical-word factor complexity, frequency discrepancy and product envelopes through length 23 for two irrational slopes; finite tests do not prove the infinite separation induction.
